args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but FIN-212 requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail, since `tests/test_money.py` asserts `2.665 -> 2.66`.

## Change
- Replaced `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
